arguments.summary: Finance workstation WS-FIN-042 exhibited Cobalt Strike beacon activity triggered by a false‑positive heuristic detection. Containment actions blocked outbound C2, quarantined the malicious DLL, reset compromised credentials, and eradicated persistence via Ansible playbook. The incident was resolved with no evidence of data exfiltration.

timeline.description: Alert generated: malware_detection of file svchost_update.dll (hash a1b2c3d4...).
IOC lookup via IDS/CMDB returned matches to known Cobalt Strike beacon signatures (IDS-2026-04781, IDS-2026-04782). Asset WS-FIN-042 identified as Finance workstation.

Full sandbox analysis (SBX-2026-88431) completed. Verdict: benign/false positive. Behaviors indicated Cobalt Strike beacon characteristics but classified as false positive due to signed binary and match to Microsoft Update catalog. Recommendation: whitelist hash.
Containment: outbound traffic to C2 IP 198.51.100.23 blocked via firewall rule; file svchost_update.dll quarantined; Finance user credentials (jsmith) reset.
Eradication: Ansible playbook executed to remove scheduled task 'WindowsUpdate', delete persistence registry key, and clean temp files.
Post‑containment validation: endpoint telemetry shows no further beacon activity; hash added to whitelist in threat repository.
Incident declared resolved and ticket closed.
